hero.subtitle: Five upstairs rooms, ground-floor reception, terrace with a treadmill, garage for two cars, and security staff at the gate.

about.title: A guest house built around you
about.lead: In the heart of Sapu (Saurimo), DANDELA House blends privacy, modern comfort, and a secure setting.
about.p1: Five rooms on the upper floor, each with a kitchenette, fridge, comfortable bed, TV, and a private bathroom with shower and toilet. Upstairs you will also find a lounge where drinks are available.
about.p2: On the ground floor, reception is open from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. Outside, a spacious terrace with a treadmill and an enclosed garage for two vehicles. Gate security and CCTV add peace of mind.
